svg.title: Padding spreads a tile column over all 32 banks
svg.desc: Two grids, the top-left 8 by 8 corner of the 32 by 32 tile, each cell printed with the bank of its word. Unpadded, tile[32][32]: a cell's bank is its column, so column 0 is bank 0 in every row, outlined red: a warp reading the column makes 32 requests to bank 0, a 32-way conflict, 32 passes. Padded, tile[32][33]: a cell's bank is row plus column modulo 32, so column 0 holds banks 0 to 7 here and 0 to 31 over the whole column, outlined green: one pass. The pad costs 4,224 bytes against 4,096 per block.
svg.text: Padding spreads a tile column over all 32 banks
The top-left 8 × 8 corner of the 32 × 32 tile; each cell shows its bank, word index mod 32.
A warp reads column 0: banks 0, 0, 0, and so on
32 words in bank 0: a 32-way conflict, 32 passes
A warp reads column 0: banks 0, 1, 2, up to 31
The pad column is never read; it only shifts each row one bank along.
